claim_boundary: The stress-drop metric uses exact per-interval response histories where retained and atomic-chunk endpoints elsewhere. Qualification requires per-interval diagnostics in both terminal controls plus a fully banded terminal chunk, >5% adiabatic post-peak loss, >1% softening separation from the matched bath, >20 K spatial thermal contrast separation, RX overlap, exact branch continuity, and all hard ledgers. It does not establish spontaneous grain birth or material calibration.
